namespace: staff; never customer identity and never legacy login import

operations.scope: authorized current staff records in supplier mode; source/keyword/enabled filters before count and paging; restricted warehouse/supplier identities denied
operations.order: created_at DESC default, staff_id ASC final tie break; exact SQL order allowlist

operations.scope: new staff ID and authorized supplier-mode record; no email-based historical lookup; 404 if absent/invisible

response_headers.Location: detail path for created staff ID

operations.invariant: one MySQL transaction for fresh staff/password credential/supplier mode/source/order grants/audit/idempotent result; supplier restrictions before login eligibility; reject duplicate canonical staff email; never reset existing password; source supplier type and every order checked
operations.secret_handling: password only in bounded request memory and secure KDF input; never persisted in request JSON/log/audit/error/idempotency result. Canonical body dedupe uses a domain-separated keyed HMAC with versioned protected server key, not unkeyed password SHA. KDF/HMAC execution and rotation remain implementation work.

operations.invariant: path identifies current new-system staff; forbid binding self; validate supplier source and every order, normalize order IDs; lock target and permissions in transaction, compare version, replace rather than add supplier restrictions, increment entity and permission versions, audit, persist operation result. An existing account is required; no identity creation or password change here. Runtime mode invariant denies generic staff/admin grants while supplier mode applies.
operations.replay: same operation key and canonical body/precondition returns original result only after current actor/target authorization; dedupe before rejecting the replay's old If-Match; new key with stale version conflicts. Changed body or precondition with same key conflicts.

errors.fields: exact invalid paths; no raw values or passwords
source_id; missing, deleted or not supplier type
order_ids or authorized individual indexes; do not reveal foreign orders
email; only authorized manager can receive duplicate staff information

normalization_and_parsing: HTTP JSON rejects duplicate keys, invalid UTF-8, extra documents and unknown fields; schema does not enforce raw-byte parsing

Email UI trims prior to submit; server accepts only bounded ASCII email without whitespace. Preserve display case, use separate ASCII-lower canonical email unique within new staff identity namespace; same customer email remains independent, no historical ownership matching
Passwords stay byte-exact UTF-8; length in Unicode code points 12..128, no trim/casefold/truncation. Old bcrypt max72 draft cannot satisfy this contract
IDs preserve exact case; no whitespace or scalar-to-string coercion; validate actual source/order existence and permission under locks
Order ID duplicates normalize to unique binary-sorted IDs before authorization/hash/storage; [] no order grants

GET query decoder accepts one occurrence per known key, canonical nonnegative decimal limit/offset strings and true/false booleans; parse to typed ListQuery without JS floating-point coercion. Defaults applied explicitly. Reject unknown/repeated keys, signs, decimals and scientific notation
Positive revisions are text and strong quoted ETags; also bound to signed BIGINT <=9223372036854775807 at runtime. No weak/wildcard If-Match; absent 428, malformed 400, mismatched 409
Response exposes no password/hash/auth_identity/session/raw metadata; operation replay uses same projection and current authorization
remaining: Gin handlers and raw HTTP decoder
full staff selector and permissions contracts
KDF and protected HMAC key implementation
Redis session revocation and permission checks
Ant Design UI and full workflow verification
